name: discordbotcam
description: Discord bot with welcome images, GitLab connection helper, and safe Web3 gas status commands.

scripts.canvas:smoke: node -e "const { createCanvas } = require('canvas'); const canvas = createCanvas(2, 2); const png = canvas.toBuffer('image/png'); if (!Buffer.isBuffer(png) || png.length === 0) throw new Error('canvas smoke test failed'); console.log('canvas smoke test passed:', png.length, 'bytes');"
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run canvas:smoke
